ModMetaData.name: Meals at Work
ModMetaData.author: CH4AcKO3
ModMetaData.description: When pawns get hungry while crafting or researching, they order a meal. Haulers collect several meals per trip and bring food to them so they can eat at their workstation and save the trip to the dining room. Keep working while eating, take an automatic lunch break, or use an idle worktable as a dining spot. Customize meal preferences, delivery waiting time and the small workstation dining mood effect. Colonists, hauling mechs and trained hauling animals can deliver meals. Supports RimWorld 1.6 and 简体中文; requires Harmony.
